protocol.pilot_sizing_rule: 1.25 times maximum pilot cash draw, fronting, and directional requirement; no holdout resizing
protocol.initial_balance_rule: Each holder starts with the same gross principal in each mechanism; Ark board service fees reduce its claims.
protocol.receipt_policy: One fresh single-participant round per accepted receipt; net claim plus 330-sat root overhead, 3857-sat miner fee.
protocol.refresh_policy: Each claim refreshes separately at expiry minus 288 or after 99 retained-change hops; failed maintenance retries every six blocks before expiry.
protocol.sweep_policy: One transaction per inactive root at expiry plus delay, 1295-sat fee; live claims or net output below 330 prevent recovery.
protocol.dust_policy: Fresh round outputs require 330 sats. Retained Arkoor change may be subdust. Receipt dust rejection belongs to this fresh-round policy, not a universal inbound protocol restriction.
protocol.routing_policy: Instantaneous direct settled payments, zero route fee; outbound admissibility reserves 90% of holder fee. No rebalance.
protocol.channel_policy: One channel per holder or group; group shares directional capacity but cannot spend another holder's balance. No channel rotation or rebalance.
limitations: Receipt backing policy has not been observed live; it is a declared fresh-root scenario.
Observed single-participant transaction fees are held constant; pooled tree batching is not estimated.
Six blocks is the recorded detection gap, not an operational distribution; 144 is stress.
Successful settlement is instantaneous. HTLC duration and sat-seconds are unavailable, not measured zero.
Full channel funding includes both parties; operator-only conservation is checked separately.
Fee spend is reported separately from capital-time. Lower remaining assets after miner fees do not establish funding efficiency.
Ratios are comparable only when both mechanisms meet the declared delivery target.
